At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''enclave''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bpfassh]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.75 BBY]], all members of that training facilty [[Dark Jedi/Legends|went rogue]] and started [[Bpfassh Uprising|wreaking havoc]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] until they were stopped by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and his strike team.<ref name="TNEC" />
